retrievalProfile.description: A retro country-western aesthetic featuring a high-contrast portrait framed by arched display type and a textured, sepia-toned background on a rounded square substrate.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central high-contrast monochrome portrait of a man in a cowboy hat, set against a warm, mottled sepia background. The composition is framed within a rounded square with a metallic edge, featuring arched serif typography at the top and vertical outlined text on the left.
coreVisualRelationships: Arched display text follows the curve of the cowboy hat brim
Vertical text on the left acts as a structural border element
High-contrast facial features anchor the center of the composition
Circular badge in the bottom right balances the top-heavy typography
coreInvariants: Rounded square frame with a subtle 3D metallic bevel effect
Mottled, warm-toned parchment texture in the background
High-contrast black and white portraiture style

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central portrait, head and shoulders, filling approximately 70% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the arched name at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the arched name, follows the hat brim down to the face, moves to the vertical text on the left, and finishes at the circular badge on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the background is filled with texture and secondary graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia and cream tones for the background and skin highlights.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for shadows, hair, and clothing details.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Burnt orange and gold for the primary typography and badge highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the central portrait.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to sepia, black, white, and orange-gold

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classic slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary name is arched with a heavy drop shadow
Vertical text uses outlined characters with star motifs
Secondary text is set in a condensed, clean sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the vertical title are hollow outlines
Main name features a slight gradient and thick black offset shadow
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Bold arched slab serif for the name paired with a vertical outlined sans-serif for the series title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the slab-serif weight and classic western feel for the main name.
Good base for the condensed secondary text if outlined.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a man in a cowboy hat on a mottled sepia-toned background, framed in a rounded square with a metallic edge.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add arched orange-gold slab-serif text at the top with a heavy black shadow, and vertical outlined sans-serif text on the left margin.

verificationChecks: Is the main name arched over the hat?
Is the background texture visible and warm-toned?
Is there a circular badge in the bottom right?

adjustableVariables: Contrast level of the central portrait
mustRedesign: Exact song titles or brand logos
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not obscure the eyes of the subject.
Ensure the metallic border looks like a physical tin edge.
Verify the vertical text is legible as an outline.
Confirm the sepia tone is consistent across the background.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Arched Slab Serif + Vertical Outlined Text + Sepia Texture + Rounded Square Frame
